content.text: E KAWASANA OPU, i Ingkoomo kudoʼa!
E Aulataʼalaku, i Ingkoomo kuparacaea,
maasangia inda kupotibhaaka kaea,
tee bholi utaroakea manga musuku apotawaikiaku.
Bhari-bharia mia moharapuna i Ingkoo inda bheanamisi kaea,
maka manga mia mohianatia inda tee sababuna bheanamisi kaea.
E KAWASANA OPU, paumbaakaaku manga dhalamu,
adhariakaaku manga parintamu.
Bhawaaku kulingka i nuncana kabanaramu tee uadhariaku,
roonamo Ingkoomo Aulataʼala mopasalaamatiaku,
iaku kuantaantagiko saeoa.
E KAWASANA OPU, udhania rahumatimu tee kaasimu molagina
roonamo bhari-bharia sumai adhaangiamo minaaka i zamani mangenge.
Dosa-dosa wakutuuna amangura dhadhiku,
tee manga kasalaha ipewauku bholimo uudhania,
tabeana udhaniaku apokana tee kaasimu molagina
roonamo kalapena incamu, e KAWASANA OPU.
KAWASANA OPU sumai amalape tee amakate totona incana,
sababuna Incia asusuaka dhala to manga mia mokodosa.
KAWASANA OPU akapalai mia inda mosombo i dhala mobanara,
tee manga incia aadhariakea tee opea ipeeluna.
Bhari-bharia dhalana KAWASANA OPU abukeaka tee kaasi molagina tee amembali atoparacaea
to mia mopengkenina i pojanjiana tee manga kaudhaniana.
E KAWASANA OPU, roonamo saromu
amponia o kasalahaku moomini amaoge o kasalahaku sumai.
Incema mia momaekana i KAWASANA OPU?
KAWASANA OPU bheasusuakea dhala to idhalikina.
Manga incia bheasadhaadhaa adhadhi amasanaa,
tee manga siwuluna mokotinaurakaakana alamu.
KAWASANA OPU aposabhangka tee manga mia momaekaia,
tee asusuaka o antona pojanjiana to manga incia.
Mataku sadhaadhaa atonto KAWASANA OPU,
roonamo Incia bheapasalaamatiaku minaaka i balaa.
Tontoaku, tee umaasiakaaku,
roonamo kumalino tee kutopisaki.
Pekalalesaia o ngangarandaku sii minaaka i kasukara,
rambasakaaku minaaka i kanarakaaku.
Tilikia kanarakaaku tee kasukaraku,
tee amponia bhari-bharia dhosaku.
Kamatea, tapanamo kabhari o musuku,
tee manga incia abanciaku mpuu.
Jagania inyawaku tee pasalaamatiaku,
bholi utaroakaaku kupotibhaaka kaea roonamo Ingkoo peulusaku.
Maasangia o kakatena totona incamu tee kajujurumu ajaganiaku,
sababuna kuharapu i Ingkoo.
E Aulataʼala, tolosia manga miana Israel minaaka i bhari-bharia kasukarana!
